reflection: Across 7 rounds, nearly every factor helps in 2023 and 2025 and hurts in 2022 and 2024, so the pattern looks regime-driven. Volume-based relative signals (AAPL vs QQQ/NVDA volume z-scores) are the only ones with consistent gains for both LR and RF, but 2022 and 2024 fail. Price-return variants are near-copies of existing factors. I will try volume signals with trend/volatility conditioning to fix 2022 and 2024, and some new ideas such as lagged and multi-day quantities, range-based peer measures, and volume rank-type features that differ from earlier ones.

lessons.name: aapl_vs_nvda_volume_change_1d
lessons.lesson: One-day log volume change differences helped LR in 3 years but were tiny and RF ignored them, so the signal is weak and mostly linear.

lessons.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_surge_60d_base
lessons.lesson: A slower QQQ volume baseline improved the AAPL-vs-QQQ volume contrast slightly and helped both models, but still failed in 2022 and 2024.

lessons.name: aapl_down_volume_pressure
lessons.lesson: Volume-weighted 5d return sum was essentially a copy of AAPL_mean_return_5d, so it added nothing and inherited its regime flipping.

lessons.name: aapl_range_expansion_vs_5d
lessons.lesson: Range relative to its recent average mostly repeats the daily range and only helped RF in calm 2023 and 2025.

lessons.name: qqq_trend_regime_20_60
lessons.lesson: A slow QQQ trend gauge is a level-type feature that drifted across years, badly hurting 2024 and giving no stable signal.

lessons.name: aapl_minus_nvda_1d_return
lessons.lesson: Apple minus NVDA daily return is nearly the same as the existing peer-mean relative factor, so it was redundant and unstable.

factors.name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_60d_both
factors.hypothesis: The 20d-vs-60d mix fails in 2022 and 2024 probably because regimes shift the volume level; using the same 60d window on both sides gives a cleaner relative attention contrast that is less dependent on short bursts.

factors.name: aapl_vs_nvda_volume_surge_vol_scaled
factors.hypothesis: The volume contrast failed in high-vol 2022 and low-vol 2024 because its effect scales with volatility; dividing by Apple's 20d volatility normalises it across regimes.

factors.name: aapl_close_vs_prior_5d_low_range
factors.hypothesis: Stochastic-style position within the 10d high-low channel captures overbought or oversold state, which differs from the one-day close position and from MA distance.

factors.name: qqq_down_day_count_10d
factors.hypothesis: The fraction of up versus down QQQ days over 10 sessions measures market breadth in direction, not magnitude, and may separate trending from choppy regimes.

factors.name: aapl_lag_return_2d_vs_msft
factors.hypothesis: Yesterday's MSFT lead over Apple provides a catch-up signal, which complements a volume attention signal by describing the delayed peer move.

factors.name: qqq_volume_trend_vs_aapl_range
factors.hypothesis: Market-wide volume jumps without a matching range expansion indicate quiet accumulation or absorption; this market state complements Apple's volume relative to NVDA.
